bodyLength.label: Body length
bodyLength.help: From the top of the shoulder (beside the neck) down to the hem at the centre.

neckWidth.label: Neck width
neckWidth.help: Distance across the neck opening, side to side.

neckDepthFront.label: Front neck depth
neckDepthFront.help: How far the front neckline dips below the shoulder line.

neckDepthBack.label: Back neck depth
neckDepthBack.help: How far the back neckline dips below the shoulder line.

collarWidth.label: Collar rib width
collarWidth.help: Width of the ribbed band around the neck. 0 = raw edge, no rib.

chestHalf.label: Chest width
chestHalf.help: Body width just below the armpits.

hemHalf.label: Hem width
hemHalf.help: Body width at the bottom edge. Wider than the chest flares out; narrower tapers in.

hemOffset.label: Side hem length
hemOffset.help: How much longer (+) or shorter (-) the hem is at the side seam compared with the centre.

shoulderHalf.label: Shoulder width
shoulderHalf.help: Width across the shoulders, seam to seam.

shoulderDrop.label: Shoulder slope
shoulderDrop.help: How far the shoulder seam drops from the neck to the shoulder point. Negative raises the shoulder.

armholeDepth.label: Armhole depth
armholeDepth.help: Vertical distance from the shoulder point down to the armpit.

sleeveLength.label: Sleeve length
sleeveLength.help: Along the top of the sleeve, from the shoulder point to the cuff. 0 = sleeveless.

sleeveOpening.label: Sleeve opening
sleeveOpening.help: Width of the sleeve at the cuff edge.

sleeveAngle.label: Sleeve angle
sleeveAngle.help: Angle of the sleeve below horizontal. 0 = straight out like a T, higher values hang down.
